meaning:
τρυφάω, -ῶ
(τρυφή), [in LXX: Neh.9:25 (עָדַן hithp.), Isa.66:11 (עָנַג hithp.), Sir.14:4 * ;]
to live daintily, luxuriously, to fare sumptuously: Jas.5:5 (cf. ἐν-τρυφάω).†
SYN.: σπαταλάω (which see), στρηνιάω (AS)

elsewhere.note: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
